title: Pack the Context
briefMd:
# Phase 6 · Pack the Context

Every team copied the engineering handbooks into its own wiki space and changed a word or two. A search now returns five near-identical copies of a handbook before the one page that actually answers, and the copies fill the context budget before the answer gets in.

Retrieval is BM25 over whole pages. The context is then **packed**: duplicates are dropped, and the remaining pages are added in rank order while they fit the token budget. You control **topK** (how many pages the search returns), **dedupe** (`none`, `exact`: identical text only, or `near`: pages whose words overlap enough) and **dedupeThreshold** (for `near`: the share of distinct words two pages must have in common to count as copies).

**Gates:** recall@k ≥ 0.90 and mean prompt tokens ≤ 130 on the hidden set. The budget is also the packing limit: pages that do not fit are left out.

dedupe.description: exact drops identical pages; near drops pages whose words overlap at least the threshold.

dedupeThreshold.description: near only: share of distinct words two pages must share to count as copies.
